panels.title: Order rate (last 5 min)
panels.description: Orders placed per second across all markets, including rejections. Excludes nothing — every POST /api/v1/orders that reached the engine.

panels.title: Rejection rate (last 5 min)
panels.description: Share of orders the engine rejected. Healthy: <5%. Persistent >20% means validation is too strict or a client is misbehaving.

panels.title: Trades/sec (last 5 min)
panels.description: Fills produced by the engine. One row per Trade, so an issuance fill that mints YES+NO counts as 2.

panels.title: Drift events (24h)
panels.description: Reconciler-detected collateral discrepancies in the last 24 hours. Should be 0 in steady state. Each event has a row in prediction_collateral_ledger with the cents amount.

panels.title: Order rate by status
panels.description: Time series of order placements split by terminal status. Watch the rejected line for spikes correlated with deploys or feature flips.

panels.title: Order rate by side / action
panels.description: Time series split by side (yes/no) and action (buy/sell). A sustained imbalance is a useful signal — e.g. heavy buy-yes flow with no sell-yes makers will exhaust the book quickly.

panels.title: Top 10 markets by order rate
panels.description: Hottest markets in the last 1 minute. Use this to spot single-market load that might be saturating the per-market advisory lock (375 ops/sec ceiling per the load harness baseline).

panels.title: Trades by kind (secondary vs issuance)
panels.description: Secondary fills are taker-vs-maker on the same side (real CLOB depth getting hit). Issuance fills mint YES+NO pairs against opposite-side buy orders. A market with only issuance trades has no resting same-side liquidity.

panels.title: Reconciler outcomes
panels.description: Per-tick reconciler results. Clean = invariants hold. Drift = adjustment written. Error = reconciler iteration failed (DB unreachable, market disappeared, etc). Sustained error > 0 needs investigation.

panels.title: Settlements (1h)
panels.description: Markets settled. Override = the admin needed to supply an override reason because the gateway detected collateral imbalance pre-settle. A trickle of overrides is fine; a steady stream means matching is producing inconsistent state.

panels.title: Drift events — by market (last 24h)
panels.description: Per-market drift event counter for the last 24 hours. Markets at the top of this table need a manual reconciliation pass.

panels.title: SMM skips by reason (last 1h)
panels.description: Reasons the synthetic market maker declined to post a quote. position_cap = market's bot inventory hit SMM_MAX_POSITION_QTY (defensive — bot stops accumulating one side). price_band = market sits at the edge of [1,99] and a symmetric quote would fall outside. Sustained position_cap on one market means users are only taking one side; investigate market dynamics.

panels.title: SMM skips — top markets (last 1h)
panels.description: Markets where the SMM is throttling. Reason=position_cap indicates the bot has reached its position limit on that side and has stopped posting quotes there. Workflow: confirm the bot's actual position vs SMM_MAX_POSITION_QTY, decide whether to raise the cap or take inventory off the books.
